layers.description: Publish the V1.29.6.2 wrist-grip and V1.29.7 operational-rider APIs only once their boots finish (fixes the intermittent V1.30 boot crash)
Real-time pneumatic brush tire model (RTT)
RTT into V5 free road, real-time fixed-step loop, lite telemetry, throttled rider bridge
Implicit wheel spin, suspension end-of-travel physics, chain force routing (anti-squat), aerodynamics, rider feet-down support, impulse joint limits
Physical rider: segment masses, pelvis/torso posture servos with reactions at seat/pegs/bars, hang-off, tuck, weight shift, stand; drives legacy rider pose and aero posture

LUCID canonical female-skin-v4.2: Semantic51 compiler, canonical helper-cluster rules and Skin78 LBS in float64 (parity with the R1.5 Python reference), declared hand layer + grip synergies, 17-segment 75 kg physical profile
Articulated-body dynamics (Featherstone ABA, floating base + revolute hinges, stable-PD armature, RNEA) for the physical rider

The rider's muscles: the R1.5 musculotendon proxies (84; the triceps as a declared candidate split into the three Holzbaur heads with an olecranon point: 88) on her skeleton - path lengths and virtual-work moment arms, MuJoCo's muscle force-length-velocity and activation dynamics, and the allocation of joint-torque intent to activations inside what one step can reach (parity with the package: tests/rider_muscles.test.mjs)

Physical rider: the LUCID character as an articulated body (Semantic51 hinges, R1.5 17-body profile, skin-fitted contact spheres) on the 916's contact surfaces (envelope SDF, pegs, grips, ground); torque-limited servos, IK planner (world-referenced trunk/head, hang-off/tuck/stand, braking brace), coupled into the V5 multibody

The physical rider drawn through the canonical skin path (compile -> helper clusters -> Skin78 LBS) every frame from her body's Semantic51 commands + placement; hands closed on the grips with the declared bottle grip synergy; legacy mannequins hidden while she is active

Her clothes: the LUCID Clothing Engine (Human Engine M26 cloth solver + Clothing Engine R1 wardrobe, vendored unchanged) simulating the T-shirt and jeans on her drawn skin, in a frame riding with the bike (gravity less its acceleration, the air as wind)

Her hair: the DDHF V25 hair engine's clump charts (twist-optical rank: packed RGB8 twist coefficients, the m2 secondary lobe) on a groom from the hair cards of the Human Engine model she was made with; strands with follow-the-leader inextensibility, root-to-tip shape memory, collisions with her head, neck and shoulders, gravity less the bike's acceleration and the air seen from the bike

Her sunglasses ('Sunglasses' by martn00, Sketchfab, CC-BY-4.0), fitted to her face by tools/character/fit-glasses.mjs - on the bridge of her nose, the temples opened and lengthened to rest where her ears join her head - carried rigidly by her Head joint; rose-gold metal, red-tinted lenses, clear pads and tips in the scene's lights

The physical rider off the bike: on her feet (stand, walk, run, step-turn: capture-point stepping, centre-of-pressure control through compliant ankles, virtual-model support, a declared capped pelvis balance assist), getting up after a fall, lifting the bike and getting on / off (F / pad X); third-person camera and controls while she is off the bike

POSE LAB: the animator's controls on the riding rider - posture shapes (planner priors per posture) and joint style (IK preferred angles and weights), live or frozen (the IK pose for her targets); pose sets saved / loaded as JSON (lucid.rider.pose-set.v1), the shown pose as BVH and OBJ
Fabric lab: heatmaps (tension, stretch, thickness, bend, friction, damping, wrinkle) and crease strokes painted on her jeans' flats, baked into the clothing engine's fabric fields; JSON import/export
Proving ground: 3 km circuit + test apron; shared height/signed-distance fields for tire physics and GPU terrain; sky, fog, soft bike shadow, minimap, lap timer
Rubber marks: toroidal R8 deposit map around the bike, stamped from RTT frictional energy per swept patch area (burnouts, lock-ups, slides); sampled by the terrain shader
In-frame volumetric effects: physics-driven tire smoke, exhaust heat/vapour, afterfire flames, brake heat haze, grass/dirt

Exhaust gas dynamics: crank-phased pulses, overrun misfire / limiter-cut parcels through the pipes, ignition from V1.25 pulse/wall temperatures, afterfire flames (blackbody) + V1.22 DSP pops from the same bangs, pulsed shimmer and cold-start condensation at the measured silencer tips
NIMBUS volumetric rear-tire smoke (from the V85.10 VOLUMETRICS build): Eulerian carrier solver in a worker + raymarched Perlin-Worley smoke, driven by RTT sliding power and V1.26 tread temperature
Tire squeal (RTT sliding power / sliding speed, stick-slip), rolling road roar by surface, wind roar by airspeed / tuck / camera, mixed into the V1.22 audio graph
Feel HUD (T): per-tire friction circles with trail, loads and load transfer, slip, fork/rear travel with end-stop zones, attitude, rider posture, inputs
Rider-in-the-loop maneuver library (brake, stoppie, wheelie, launch, lean, slalom) for tests and console
